data.name: Home_NothingPlaying_Detail
data.value: Play a song in Spotify, your browser or any player, and it shows here.

data.name: Lyrics_Off
data.value: Lyrics are off. Turn them on in Settings, Music and lyrics.

data.name: Lyrics_Unavailable
data.value: LRCLIB cannot be reached right now.

data.name: Live_Empty_Detail
data.value: Claude Code, Codex and your scripts show here while they work.

data.name: Card_TooLong
data.value: Too long to check here: answer in the terminal.

data.name: Tools_Clipboard_Empty
data.value: Copied text shows here, kept in memory only.

data.name: General_Launch
data.value: Open Col when you sign in

data.name: General_Launch_Detail
data.value: Col starts with Windows and waits at the top of the screen.

data.name: General_AtRest
data.value: Show the island when nothing happens

data.name: General_AtRest_Detail
data.value: Off, the island only comes out when something happens, or when you rest the pointer at the top edge of the screen.

data.name: General_Hover_Detail
data.value: Rest the pointer on the island to open it. Off, a click opens it.

data.name: General_Size_Detail
data.value: How big the island is, closed and open.

data.name: General_Display_Detail
data.value: The island sits at the top centre of this display.

data.name: General_Volume_Detail
data.value: A gauge in the island when the volume changes. Windows' own volume flyout still shows.

data.name: General_Battery_Detail
data.value: When the charger is plugged in or out, and when the battery runs low.

data.name: General_Clipboard_Detail
data.value: Your last text copies on the Tools page, kept in memory only and never written to disk. Copies that password managers mark as private are skipped.

data.name: Music_NowPlaying_Detail
data.value: The song playing in Spotify, your browser or any app in Windows' media controls, with its cover and controls.

data.name: Music_SyncedLyrics_Detail
data.value: The words of the song beside the player, line by line. Col asks LRCLIB, an open lyrics database: only the title, the artist, the album and the length of the song are sent, and the answer is kept on this PC.

data.name: Music_LineClosed
data.value: Current line in the closed island

data.name: Music_LineClosed_Detail
data.value: The line being sung, between the cover and the equalizer.

data.name: Agents_Intro
data.value: Claude Code and Codex show in the island while they work. When one asks for permission, the island opens with the whole command, Allow and Deny. Col never signs in to any AI service.

data.name: Agents_Backup
data.value: Col adds its hooks beside yours, keeps a copy of the file it edits (.col-backup) and leaves the rest untouched. Codex asks you to trust new hooks once, with /hooks.

data.name: Agents_Colctl_Detail
data.value: Your scripts put their own live activities in the island with the colctl command, from PowerShell, cmd or Git Bash.

data.name: Agents_Colctl_Missing
data.value: colctl.exe is not beside Col.exe: reinstall Col to connect agents.

data.name: About_Tagline
data.value: A Dynamic Island at the top of your screen.

data.name: About_License
data.value: Free and open source, under the MIT License.

data.name: About_Privacy_Detail
data.value: No account, no telemetry, no analytics. Col only goes on the network to ask LRCLIB for lyrics, while synced lyrics are on. Scripts and agents reach Col through a pipe only your account can open.

data.name: About_Unsigned_Detail
data.value: This preview is not signed with a code-signing certificate yet, so Windows SmartScreen may warn before the first launch: choose More info, then Run anyway.

data.name: About_Credits
data.value: The logos of coding agents come from LobeHub Icons (MIT) and belong to their owners.
